## About
Somerset Animal Clinic is a full service animal hospital located south of San Antonio in Somerset, Texas. We are proud to serve the Somerset community and their furry friends, and our office is just off the highway, so chances are good we are on your way.
Our work covers the whole life of your pet: wellness exams and immunizations, heartworm and parasite testing, dental care, general surgery, digital x-rays, in-house lab work and senior care. We also offer boarding for dogs and cats, bathing by appointment, and an online store that can deliver medications right to your front door.
Neighbors have given us 4.7 stars across 320 Google reviews. If you have a question or a worry about your pet, give us a call.

## Services
- Wellness examinations: Complete health exams to help your companions live longer and healthier lives.
- Vaccinations: A vaccination program for dogs and cats, including rabies, Bordetella, feline leukemia and a rattlesnake vaccine.
- Heartworm and parasite testing: Testing for heartworm and intestinal parasites, plus prevention and treatment.
- General surgery: Anesthetic procedures including spay, neuter, mass removals and other surgeries.
- Dental services: Dental care for your pet, with extractions when they are needed.
- Digital x-rays: Abdominal, chest and orthopedic x-rays taken right here at the clinic.
- Specialty testing: Specialty testing and urine analysis, along with wellness, pre-anesthetic and senior checks done in the clinic.
- Senior care: Care for older pets, including arthritis support and bloodwork.
- Microchip identification: Microchip implantation so your pet can be identified if they ever get lost.
- Dog and cat boarding: Kennels for dogs and cats when you need to be away.
- Bathing: A deep cleaning bath, blow dry, nail trim and ear cleaning come standard with every bath, by appointment.
- Online pharmacy: Order your pet's medications online and have them delivered to your door.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday. Give us a call if you need to check the day's hours.

Q: What should I do if my pet has an emergency?
A: Please call the clinic right away.

Q: How is boarding priced?
A: Boarding is charged by your pet's weight and the length of the stay.

Q: How do I book a bath for my pet?
A: Just give us a call and one of our staff will set up an appointment.

Q: Do you carry flea and tick prevention?
A: Yes. We carry over the counter products like Advantage, Frontline Gold and Seresto collars, and prescription options like Nexgard, Comfortis and Revolution.
